intake.duplicate_effort: none for pegainfer itself; AMD-Ecosystem/flashinfer already ROCm-ports one of its four vendored third-party kernel libs
intake.summary: Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine; GPU layer runs on cudarc (no ROCm/HIP backend anywhere in the Rust ecosystem) and its GLM5.2/Kimi-K2 kernels are Blackwell-only tcgen05/CUTLASS-CuTe PTX (DeepGEMM/FlashMLA/DeepEP submodules), matching the project's existing cant-port pattern (flashinfer, FlashKDA, mirage).
